segments.name: Health Benefits
products: Stop loss, dental, vision and supplemental health insurance
segments.description: Offers comprehensive health plans and administrative managed care services to Individual, Employer Group, Medicare, Medicaid and FEP members across multiple states.
segments.evidence: Our Health Benefits segment offers a comprehensive suite of health plans and services to our Individual, Employer Group risk-based, Employer Group fee-based, BlueCard ® , Medicare, Medicaid and FEP ® members.

segments.name: CarelonRx
segments.description: Provides comprehensive pharmacy services including home delivery, specialty pharmacy, and clinical programs to affiliated and external health plan customers.
segments.evidence: CarelonRx offers a comprehensive portfolio of pharmacy services, which includes all core pharmacy services, such as home delivery and specialty pharmacies, claims adjudication, formulary management, pharmacy networks, rebate administration, a prescription drug database and member services.

segments.name: Carelon Services
segments.description: Integrates physical, behavioral, pharmacy and social-care capabilities to support whole-health services and manage complex healthcare areas for internal and external customers.
segments.evidence: Our Carelon Services segment integrates physical, behavioral, pharmacy, and social-care capabilities to support whole-health services and enhance affordability for both internal and external customers through our Carelon Health and Carelon Insights businesses.

segments.name: Corporate & Other
segments.description: Includes businesses that do not meet quantitative thresholds for operating segments and unallocated corporate expenses.
segments.evidence: Our Corporate & Other segment includes our businesses that do not individually meet the quantitative threshold for an operating segment, as well as corporate expenses not allocated to our other reportable segments.

revenueModel.text: Company generates revenue through risk-based premiums from health plans, administrative fees from self-funded employers, and pharmacy and health service fees.
revenueModel.evidence: Across these markets, we generate revenue through risk-based premiums, administrative fees from self-funded employers and pharmacy and health service fees through our Carelon businesses.

changes.text: In 2024, CarelonRx acquired Paragon Healthcare, Inc. and its subsidiaries, adding ambulatory infusion centers to the portfolio in March 2024.
changes.evidence: In addition, CarelonRx includes ambulatory infusion centers, added to our portfolio in March 2024 through our acquisition of Paragon Healthcare, Inc. and its subsidiaries.

changes.text: In 2024, Carelon Health completed acquisition of RSV QOZB LTSS, Inc. and certain affiliated entities (d/b/a CareBridge) at the end of 2024, providing virtual care services.
changes.evidence: As a part of Carelon Health, we completed our acquisition of RSV QOZB LTSS, Inc. and certain affiliated entities (d/b/a CareBridge) at the end of 2024, which provides virtual care to complex Medicaid and Medicare patients and supports plans in managing home and community-based services.
